Closes #2849

## What changed

Folded the row-restating tests in the web's two largest test files into six `it.each` tables, per #1125's pattern 2, touching only those two files:

- [apps/web/src/fx/cues.test.ts](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-2849/apps/web/src/fx/cues.test.ts): deleted the `FX_INTENSITY_SCALE` literal pin and folded 25 `it`s into 3 `it.each` tables — `B16 recipe rows plan their S7 cues` (19 rows), `B17 card flights fly backs and land their bursts` (4 rows), `B18 buff direction follows the sign of the net` (2 rows).
- [apps/web/src/audio/cues.test.ts](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-2849/apps/web/src/audio/cues.test.ts): folded 14 `it`s into 3 `it.each` tables — `B21 amounts map to their sounds` (6 rows), `B56 summon size follows the unit the view shows` (3 rows), `catalog timbres follow the card the viewer can read` (5 rows). Both constant pins stay, each with a comment citing this change's step 9.

Every folded `it`'s events and expects survive verbatim in exactly one row: fx rows are `{ title, type, check(D) }` run through the existing `forDs(row.type, row.check)`, so each row keeps its own D-loop and readable/hidden variants; audio rows are `{ title, run() }` thunks because their assertion shapes are heterogeneous (`onlySfx` params checks vs `shape()` strings) and a data-only row would have narrowed coverage. All behavior checks (event mapping, ordering, fallbacks, missing rows, seat logic, mixer receives), every R-titled `it`, and the per-row coverage nets (fx `samples()`/11-rows loops, audio totality/silent/unconditional/through-own-row loops) are untouched. No new title holds an R-id. S2, `wire/`, sources, and spec notes are untouched.

- `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/fx/cues.test.ts` → `Test Files 1 passed`, `Tests 141 passed (141)`.

- `git status --porcelain` shows only the two files; `git diff --check` is clean; `apps/web/src/wire/` is untouched.

## Case counts and deleted tests

- fx: 142 cases before → **141 after** (`it(` blocks 142 → 116, plus 3 `it.each` tables with 19 + 4 + 2 = 25 rows).
- audio: 128 cases before → **128 after** (`it(` blocks 128 → 114, plus 3 `it.each` tables with 6 + 3 + 5 = 14 rows).

# #2849: Patch: fold the web cue tests that restate their tables row by row
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

### Kind

Architecture

### Why

This is #1125's pattern 2, the redundant tests, applied to the web's two largest test files. #1125 named both of them, and #1140 left them alone. `apps/web/src/fx/cues.test.ts` has about 142 cases and `apps/web/src/audio/cues.test.ts` about 128. Many of them check one recipe or table row each, asserting only what the table already holds. One table-driven test over the same table (`it.each` over the exported recipe or table) proves the same thing in far fewer cases.

### What to change

In those two files only:

- **Fold into `it.each`** any group of `it`s that differ only in which row they read and that assert only that row's literal fields.
- **Delete** any `it` that re-asserts a row an `it.each` (existing or new) already covers.
- **Keep** every `it` that checks behaviour: what a cue does when it plays, how it maps from an event, ordering, fallbacks, missing rows, or what the mixer receives. Also keep any `it` whose title holds an R-id as a word (CLAUDE.md rule 3), unless that ruling's note lists another file in `proven_in` that still proves it.
- **Do not touch** the S2 table in `fx/constants.test.ts`, which owns every `FX_*` number.
- The easy siblings skip `audio/cues.test.ts`, so its `expect(CONST).toBe(<literal>)` pins are yours to handle. Use #2846's rule: delete a pin if its constant is generated into `wire/*Config.ts` or is in S2.

### Acceptance

- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test`, `pnpm exec eslint apps/web` and `cargo jackioh spec check` are green.
- Only the two files change.
- Every row in each table is still covered by at least one assertion. The PR gives the case counts before and after for each file, and names each `it` deleted outright.

### Blocked by, part of

None. Follows #1125. Siblings: #2846, #2847, #2848.

### Difficulty (a guess)

medium: one app, two files, but which tests count as behaviour is a judgment call.

### Priority

No priority

### Who does it

The night bot (bot:build)
